text:
Emma: Heads-up — finalizing the 'pillars -> pulse' social plan for next product launch. Need short X copy + 1 long LinkedIn post + a 6-tweet X thread draft + 3 image variants. Target schedule: TOMORROW 10:00am PT.
Jamal: Got it. Can you drop the pillar bullets here so I can turn them into copy?
Emma: Pillars: 1) predictable low-latency inference, 2) cost controls (batching + quantization), 3) unified deployment across hosted/dedicated/private. Keep tone technical but inviting.
Kevin: For images — prefer hero + comparison graphic (latency vs cost) + carousel with 3 quick tips. I can mock up hero and comparison. Need final copy to place on designs.
Maria: I'll do LinkedIn longform. Can we add one customer quote line? "Redwood cut inference costs by 3x without sacrificing latency" - placeholder until we confirm.
Emma: yes. Use placeholder and mark as [QUOTE_PLACEHOLDER]. Also need UTMs for all links: utm_source=twitter|linkedin&utm_campaign=launch_q2&utm_medium=social.
Jamal: Draft X copy attempt: "Predictable inference, at scale. Deploy models across hosted, reserved, or private infra — without guesswork. 👉 link" Short and punchy. Want a CTA variant: "Sign up for early access" vs "See benchmarks"?
Kevin: I'd A/B CTA: tweet A -> "See benchmarks"; tweet B -> "Start free trial". Schedule both in same window, rotate per audience.
Maria: LinkedIn long post opener draft: "Shipping LLM features is easy. Shipping them reliably and affordably? Not so much. Today we’re launching Redwood Inference — a runtime + control plane built to make inference predictable across environments. Here’s how we cut unit cost and latency: [bullets]."
Emma: Nice. For the X thread, Jamal can you sketch 6 tweets: 1/ hook, 2/ problem, 3/ tech highlight (batching/cache), 4/ product highlight (dedicated/private), 5/ benchmark tease, 6/ CTA + signup link. Keep each under 280 chars.
Jamal: Thread draft (shortened lines):
1/ "Deploying LLMs shouldn’t be a gamble. Here's how we made inference predictable. ⬇️"
2/ "Problem: variance in latency & cost kills product trust. Apps need steady tail latency and predictable unit economics."
3/ "Tech: auto-batching, prefix KV caching, quantization profiles — we pick kernels per workload to keep latency tight."
4/ "Deploy: hosted API for speed, dedicated for throughput, private for regulated data — same API everywhere."
5/ "Benchmarks: 2.5x cost reduction on chat workloads at 99th p99 tail compared to naive serving (details link)."
6/ "Try it: sign up for early access + benchmark pack -> link"
Emma: Great. Kevin, can you produce hero.png, compare-chart.png, carousel-tips.png by EOD today? We need alt text too.
Kevin: Will do, pushing to /designs/launch_pillars/ by 6pm PT. Alt text: hero: "Redwood Inference logo over server racks", compare: "bar chart showing latency vs cost tradeoffs", carousel: "three tips cards: batching, caching, quantization".
Maria: For engagement follow-ups — plan: 1) Pin a thread 6 hours after launch summarizing top replies; 2) 24h post: a POV post about 'what we learned' with a short customer snippet; 3) Running replies: have 2 engineers (Jamal + Kevin) ready to answer technical Qs.
Emma: Love that. Also request: ask Growth to DM any inbound leads with >5 demo requests in the replies. Add UTMs to the sign-up link.
Jamal: I’ll be on reply duty 10-12p PT day of launch, Kevin covers 12-4p PT.
Maria: I'll schedule LinkedIn for 10:05am PT (slightly after X) and set the longform to crosspost to company page.
social-bot: Scheduled post created: channel=#x, time=2026-04-01T10:00:00-07:00, id=post_88421.
Kevin: Quick ask — can we include a small GIF showing batch pooling in the carousel? I have a 1.8s micro GIF candidate.
Emma: Yes, include it as carousel slot 2 if size <5MB.
Jamal: Final checklist for tomorrow: copy locked by 6pm; images uploaded by 6pm; UTMs confirmed; social scheduling locked; reply roster confirmed.
Emma: I'll take copy lock. Jamal, Maria — confirm by 5:30pm PT if any edits.
Maria: Confirmed, will freeze longform by 5:15pm and post schedule by 6pm.
Jamal: Confirmed.
Emma: Thanks team :rocket: Let's run a 15-min sync at 5:40pm to catch last-minute things.
social-bot: Reminder created: 15-minute meeting at 2026-04-01T17:40:00-07:00 for #marketing."
